# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is fair and ethereal-appearing with exquisite, light hair. She is radiant and blonde.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Although she presents a quiet and fair exterior, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She has a dreamy, poetic mind and is a contemplative and creative scholar.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)_

## Traits

- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- humorous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

- writing essays  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- to achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy, where she became close friends with Nell Harcourt and joined her inner circle of contemplative scholars. After graduating, she took a teaching position at the Delford school. She became an active member of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, offering to write an essay for their meetings and giving a presentation on graveyards. During a spring holiday walk in the woods with Nell, Isolde Pembroke, and Odette Pullen, she participated in naming Crystal Lake and discussing poetic thoughts about nature and human souls. She later secured a teaching position at her home school. During a visit from her aunt, the author Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, Honora brought her and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Nell at Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P28](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0028), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)_
